title: US issues power grid emergency in 13 states: Reason and what it means for residents
content: In a decisive move to ensure grid stability during a peak demand period, US Secretary of Energy Chris Wright has empowered PJM Interconnection to manage local power generation units from October 13 to October 16. With temperatures hitting unseasonably high levels, demand has surged to approximately 111,500 megawatts on October 13. While residents are not required to take action, voluntary conservation measures may be recommended.

title: Ohio brothers bought flooded quarry for $330,000; village later drops seizure bid
content: Two Ohio brothers bought a flooded quarry for $330,000 in 2005 and spent 15 years improving it before a dispute with the Village of Luckey disrupted their planned sale. After nearly five years of litigation, the village abandoned its attempt to acquire the property through eminent domain but now faces a $206,000 legal bill, with the settlement still under dispute.Is this conversation helpful so far?

title: Michael Phelps used $1m Olympic bonus to start foundation reaching 100,000 youth
content: Michael Phelps, after winning eight gold medals at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, established the Michael Phelps Foundation. This foundation focuses on promoting swimming, water safety, and healthy living for young people. Programs like 'im' aim to instill confidence and coping skills among children. The foundation has expanded to include mental health education during the COVID-19 pandemic. Partnerships with organizations ensure these programs reach diverse communities across the globe.

title: LA man paid $50 for old chair; rare 1930s design later sold for $107,950
content: Justin Miller, a home design content creator, purchased a chair from Facebook Marketplace for $50. After researching, he discovered it was a rare piece made by Frits Henningsen. Sotheby’s auctioned the chair, which was restored and had an estimated value of $30,000 to $50,000. The auction saw the chair sell for an impressive total of $107,950 including premiums. Miller continues to seek valuable items on platforms like Facebook Marketplace.

title: USCIS warns immigrants: Update home address within 10 days or risk missing documents
content: US Citizenship and Immigration Services mandates that immigrants notify them of any address changes within 10 days. Failure to report changes may lead to missed immigration documents and important notices. Changing the address with the USPS alone is insufficient, as it does not update USCIS records automatically. USCIS encourages using their online system for immediate processing of address changes.

title: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation: How is it supporting students amid controversy?

title: FIR against CJP leaders after Jantar Mantar entry, breach of peace bond alleged

The FIR includes violations of a peace bond previously signed by the leaders. CJP members protested against the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Tensions escalated after police tightened security at Jaffarpur Kalan Police Station due to protests.

title: Ronaldo’s UAE golden visa: How he keeps residency without owning property
content: Cristiano Ronaldo received the UAE Golden Visa in 2020, years before moving to Saudi Arabia’s Al-Nassr. Recognised for his achievements as an elite athlete, he qualified without needing to invest in Dubai property or establish a business. The programme’s long-term residency benefits explain how Ronaldo can continue living and playing in Saudi Arabia while maintaining ties with the neighbouring Emirates.

title: Ashok Lavasa says EC must regain public trust amid SIR controversy
content: Ashok Lavasa stressed the importance of the Election Commission regaining trust during recent protests over electoral roll irregularities. He highlighted concerns regarding the integrity of the Special Intensive Revision exercise and its impact on voter rights. The commission's credibility is questioned due to dissent among its members and lack of transparency in decision-making. Prakash Raj labeled the exercise as detrimental to democracy, extending criticism to ruling party actions.

title: Former Haryana CM Bhupinder Singh Hooda admitted to AIIMS with chest infection

His hospitalization has stirred goodwill among political opponents, with leaders from both the BJP and INLD extending wishes for his swift recovery. This incident underscores the underlying camaraderie in Haryana politics, despite the competitive landscape, especially recognizing Hooda's legacy as a former chief minister.

title: India exports 18-coach LHB train to Bangladesh with CCTVs and baby care rooms

The order covers seven different variants and further deepens the association between the two organisations. The coaches have been customised to suit Bangladesh Railway's operational requirements while providing passengers with greater comfort.

title: Can Old Monk be sold as rum? FSSAI, manufacturer lock horns in Bombay high court

FSSAI says the spirit can’t be sold simply as “rum” if it uses added flavouring, and wants a “rum-like” label. The Bombay high court, which refused interim relief, will hear the matter again on October 23.

title: Murugan offers to resign, sparks Cab reshuffle buzz
content: the union minister offered to resign from the cabinet and Rajya Sabha . he has three and a half years left of his RS term, and his exit will allow BJP to pick a new face from Madhya Pradesh .

title: Australian radio host Kyle Sandilands faces $240,000 mansion renovation lawsuit
content: australian radio host is facing a legal dispute with the builders who renovated his $3 million mansion in Glenorie, north-west Sydney . the case follows a renovation project that reportedly exceeded its original budget, leaving disagreements over costs, invoices and agreed payment arrangements .

title: Patrick Mahomes’ son Bronze: What heartwarming moment did they share?
content: the popular quarterback has remained dedicated parents to their three children in the last few years . he has opened up about raising his son bronze after he was spotted playing with him at a practice session . the three time super bowl Most Valuable Player added, “At Bronze’s age, that’s what I hope he’s doing. We’ll take it seriously when he gets a little older.”

title: Canada PM Carney to be Republic Day chief guest?
content: PM Modi and his Canadian counterpart, Mark Carney, reaffirm their commitment to finalising the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement at the earliest . the trade agreement is expected during the trip . India is also discussing a possible visit by Carney in Jan as chief guest for Republic Day .

title: Jantar Mantar denotification vindictive, vow to fight: Opposition
content: the opposition accuses modi govt of hatching a conspiracy to push protests to Delhi's fringes . the opposition vows that the fight to "restore democracy" will continue . it warns farmers and workers organisations will join the agitation soon . a tea hosted by Rahul for INDIA bloc members called it a "vindictive" step .

title: Generate questions at last minute to prevent paper leaks: Nilekani
content: questions for high-stakes entrance examinations could be generated at the last minute from a massive bank of questions . the paper would be assembled just before the examination, he said . he also said PM Modi is keen to implement the panel's recommendations .

title: 15% increase in hate crimes against Hindus in UK, home office data shows
content: police recorded a total of 146,825 hate crimes in England and Wales between March 2025 and March this year . religious hate crime rose by 13% . there was also a 15% increase in hate crimes targeting Muslims, a 10% increase targeting Jews and a 24% increase targeting Christians .

title: Pope Leo XIV undergoes successful lung surgery after cancer diagnosis
content: tests confirm a diagnosis of lung adenocarcinoma, the Vatican says . doctors are not considering chemotherapy or other therapies pending further tests . the surgery took place at Rome's Gemelli hospital and lasted around 90 minutes .

title: Rahul Gandhi peddling lies on SIR to cover Congress poll defeats: Amit Shah
content: amit Shah accuses the opposition of fabricating lies about the exercise . "you and not SIR is responsible for Congress's defeats," he says . this is the first time the opposition has taken on the opposition .

title: Opposition's plea in SC: INDIA bloc challenges SIR process but not its validity
content: opposition inDIA bloc gave up the challenge to the constitutional and statutory validity of SIR in their joint writ petition . they said they were not challenging SIR's validity in view of the SC judgement on Bihar SIR, which was conducted by EC based on its June 24, 2025, decision . that could be because EC had the power to conduct SIR and the process was proportionate to the object to be achieved .
